github: GitHub Issues through the gh CLI: labels, sub-issues, blocked-by, milestones. For teams whose code and planning already live on GitHub.
jira: Jira Cloud through acli: work types, transitions, links, JQL. For teams already on Jira, usually with an admin who can adjust the project workflow.
linear: Linear through its MCP server: projects, parent issues, relations, labels. For product teams on Linear.
notion: Notion through its MCP server: one tickets database with a board view, relations for hierarchy and blocking. For teams that plan in Notion and want tickets beside their docs.
repo: Quick setup, and the default when nothing else is chosen. Tickets are markdown files under version control: in the monorepo, or in their own repo (recommended for mono and poly repos alike). No tracker or account needed. The simplest store — right for a solo developer or a very small team with no other tracking.
trello: Trello through its MCP server: lists as status, labels as type, card links as hierarchy. For small teams that run a Trello board and want to keep it.
